//: The whole package — src, tests and the build scripts — for `pnpm -F server typecheck`. There is no separate emitting project: `backend.md` B1 replaced tsc's emit with an esbuild bundle (scripts/build.ts), because `packages/ai` and `packages/access` export TypeScript source and `packages/ai/cache-key.ts` still reaches an app module at RUN TIME (`sha1Hex` from `@/lib/dev/sha1`). So this file is `noEmit` throughout and `moduleResolution` is `bundler`, which is what the bundle actually does. `backend.md` B2 turned `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` BACK ON — B1 disabled it because its temporary dictionary pulled 40-odd apps/app modules into this program, and B2's contract flip removed every one of them; `apps/server/tests/workspace.test.ts` ties the two facts together so the strictness could not be lost quietly. The `@/*` mapping STAYS, and the reason changed: no file under `src/` uses it any more (the same test asserts that), but `packages/ai/**` is compiled as part of this program and reaches `@/lib/types`, `@/lib/dev/sha1` and friends of its own. Removing it is `packages/ai`'s to earn, not this package's to force.
